notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. IFRS. Interest paid (8,103) and interest received (14,266) are classified in operating activities per the notes; income taxes paid are in operating. Nothing is added. Two large captive-finance biases run in opposite directions: lease-asset and financial-services-receivable growth in OCF (+30,362 to paidOut) and interest/dividends received in OCF (−15,945). Sales revenue includes Financial Services revenue (62,136 total segment sales revenue, mostly leasing and interest income). Not like-for-like with automakers that book lease fleets in investing (e.g. GM). FX: calendar-2025 average.
